x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      stemmed "AI data center"
      or stemmed "AI data centre"
      or stemmed "cloud computing facility"
      or stemmed "data center"
      or stemmed "data centre"
      or stemmed "edge data center"
      or stemmed "edge data centre"
      or stemmed "high performance computing"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "backup power"
      or stemmed "critical load"
      or stemmed "emergency operation"
      or islanding
      or outage
      or resilience
    )
    and (perspective or review or survey)
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:%22AI data center%22|%22AI data centre%22|%22cloud computing facility%22|%22data center%22|%22data centre%22|%22edge data center%22|%22edge data centre%22|%22high performance computing%22,fulltext.search:%22backup power%22|%22critical load%22|%22emergency operation%22|islanding|outage|resilience,fulltext.search:perspective|review|survey&per_page=10
